messages:
alex: Heads-up: customer Meridian wants a BYO-KMS POC. They require rotation window <=1h, HSM attestation records, and end-to-end latency to KMS proxy <60ms. Any infra or SLA blockers?

cody_sales: Quick pricing ask — they want a ballpark for key-proxy overhead at ~10k reqs/min so they can include in the SOW.

sean_eng: @cody_sales rough note: network hop + HSM sign is region dependent ~35-80ms. With a local short-lived KEK cache + KV prefix cache we can drive it down to ~15-25ms for our tokenization path. Need real bench with quantized model tails.

maria.t: Security questionnaire flagged: 1) split-key / multi-custodian support, 2) FIPS-certified HSM attestation, 3) tamper-evident logs. Do we have a standard attestation pack to send?

security-bot: New security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.sec/q/meridian-qa (auto upload)

emma: For the POC I suggest we propose two options in the SOW:
- Option A: Direct BYO-KMS passthrough (no key material in Redwood).
- Option B: Hybrid: ephemeral wrapping keys created by customer KMS, short-lived unwrap inside our runtime (reduces round trips).
Note: customer policy may rule out B.

sanjay: Hybrid reduces latency but implies additional legal obligations (key-escrow/processing). Need Legal ok.

alex: Customer is strict: no escrow allowed. So Hybrid likely off the table unless we can guarantee no persistent key material. Can we do a KEK cache approach that still satisfies no-escrow?

sean_eng: We can implement a short-lived KEK cache (TTL 5m) that stores only wrapped/unwrapped ephemeral keys in memory, never persisted to disk. Rotation semantics: webhook from customer's KMS -> immediate cache invalidation -> handshakes for new KEK. Need to document revocation behavior.

maria.t: They also want rotation proofs (signed logs) going back 90 days in CSV format. Can runtime produce that?

sean_eng: Yes — runtime already emits per-KMS-op audit events. We'll add an attestation entry with HSM serial + signature chained to the log. Need SRE to configure retention and export.

cody_sales: Back to pricing: what's the incremental cost for proxying KMS calls? They want per-hour and per-request estimates to build into the POC quote.

sean_eng: Preliminary ballpark: proxy + network + HSM latency overhead -> rough $0.006–$0.009 per request at 10k req/min, depending on retry rate and region. I'll run microbench tomorrow and give concrete numbers.

alex: Add this to the SOW: explicit fallback policy and wording. Customer will only accept fallback to Redwood-managed keys if there's an explicit manual approval flow. No silent automatic fallback.

maria.t: Action: need a one-page security note + attestation artifact template. @sean_eng can you draft by EOD?

sean_eng: On it. Draft runbook + sample config below: 
``
kms_proxy:
  mode: passthrough
  cache_ttl: 300s
  max_conns: 250
  retry_policy:
    attempts: 3
    backoff_ms: 200
  audit:
    emit_attestation: true
    attestation_format: csv
    retention_days: 90
```

cody_sales: Good. Also need SOW line items for: key-rotation support, audit retention 90d, attestation delivery, per-request proxying cost, and a throughput SLA.

emma: Ops note: include a runbook snippet for failed unwrapping (example steps: check KMS certs, flush cache, initiate manual key-handoff) and escalation contacts (customer security + RW key-ops).

alex: Meridian also asked for a live attestation during onboarding (video + HSM serial + signed challenge). Can we support scheduling that?

maria.t: Legal: must include DPA + KMS SLA exceptions (no auto-wrap fallback, mandatory notification window).

alex: Next steps: @sean_eng perf microbench (provide per-region latencies + per-request cost), @maria.t security note & attestation template, @cody_sales draft SOW with explicit fallback language and pricing estimate. I'll coordinate scheduling for live attestation if SOW accepted. :thumbsup:
